title: 番茄新书《宇宙职业选手》已经正式发布！
content_zh:
新书简介：

2036年，人类第一次登上了荧火星。

2052年，第一届世界武道大赛举行，这也是全球最高格斗赛事，全球为之狂热。

世界级顶尖选手“枪魔”许景明，于二十六岁那年，带着征战赛事留下的一身伤病，选择了退役……

一个风起云涌的新时代，开始了！

《吞噬星空》番茄新书《宇宙职业选手》已经正式发布！ 正在手打中，请稍等片刻，

内容更新后，请重新刷新页面，即可获取最新更新！
content_en:
Introduction to the new book:

In 2036, humans landed on Mars for the first time.

In 2052, the first World Martial Arts Competition was held. This was also the world's highest fighting event, and the whole world was crazy about it.

The world's top player "Gun Demon" Xu Jingming chose to retire at the age of 26 with injuries from competing in tournaments...

A turbulent new era has begun!

"Swallowing Stars" Tomato's new book "Cosmic Professionals" has been officially released!Currently being typed, please wait a moment.
